label: No Jump Wolf Transformation
summary: Transforming into the Wolf no longer makes Alucard hop upward at the end of the transformation.

vanilla.reason: The instruction is identical in vanilla and the change only stores zero instead of -1.5 to PLAYER.velocityY.

overlaps.detail: No other hack or PPF writes WolfStepS_8 (0x8012E9C0-0x8012EAD0); the single-high-jump / revert PPFs do not touch it.

notes: Source: Wolf-Transformation-No-Jump.ppf + README/manifest (Codex 2026-09-29/s-3); decomp src/dra/wolfForm.c WolfStepS_8 line 1023. Only byte 0x8EABE changes (0x22 -> 0x20, rt v0 -> zero). v == o == e43322ac; both code paths into the store load v0 = 0xFFFE8000 (-1.5) first, so the hop is removed in all cases.
